acceptanceCriteria.text: Room members-<uuid> and files-<uuid> pseudo-collections resolve to REAL Folder scenario-units (identity/parent/children as real links) — NOT 'no scenario'.

The folder detail renders a child-size SUNBURST diagram, RIDING R40.16's folder-as-unit + type-driven detail + child-size sunburst — verify-owner-first: reuse R40.16 (cc875e35), do NOT duplicate the folder model or the sunburst renderer.
[DEVICE-ONLY @390 pixel — Tron on phone, NEVER headless-green, TRON-ONLY] Tron verifies in-room Files/Members render as a REAL folder with a sunburst diagram, not 'no scenario'.

The sunburst ARC SIZE = the ACTUAL ON-DISK CONTENT SIZE in BYTES, NOT a uniform per-file count (Tron 2026-09-01: 'the actual content size on disk, real bytes per file or child'). DERIVED metric per unit type: (1) a FILE's size = its byte size on disk; (2) a FOLDER's size = the RECURSIVE SUM of all descendant file bytes; (3) a VIRTUAL unit with no physical location (e.g. a room collection) = the recursive byte-sum of its RESOLVABLE children (it AGGREGATES its children's real bytes), which is 0 if none are byte-bearing; (4) EMPTY (0 children) = the defined empty-state (size 0, a defined empty ring, NEVER blank) — the existing empty-state AC still holds; (5) a ZERO-BYTE or no-bytes child renders a MINIMUM-visible arc (a small floor) so it does NOT vanish, preserving arc-count == direct-child-count. The PROPORTIONALITY discriminator is KEPT: LARGEST size = LARGEST arc — only the METRIC changes from count to bytes. @390 screenshot-checkable: a folder containing a large file shows a proportionally LARGER arc than a folder containing a small file (not equal arcs). stub-must-fail: uniform sizing (equal arcs for children of UNEQUAL byte size) => RED.
